kiosks.title: Fleet Pipeline
kiosks.body:
prompt → worldlabs-mcp → Marble UUID
portals.json → Godot hub → Butler → itch.io

Each ring is a public Marble splat.
The hub is agent-built; worlds open in your browser.

kiosks.title: Agent Log (replay)
kiosks.body:
> plan worlds A–Z with gallery-style prompts
> worldlabs_world.generate × 8
> download_world_thumbs.ps1
> hub_manager ring layout + tour save
> ship-itch.ps1 --hidden

Press E at any terminal for portal-specific notes.

kiosks.title: Photo Challenge
kiosks.body:
Stand inside a ring frame.
Screenshot for itch / social.
Tag: Marble Adventure prototype.

Bonus: visit featured worlds in shape order
● ■ ▲ ◆ ★ for Architect credit.

gothic_cathedral.spark_welcome: Gothic Cathedral. Vaulted stone, rose light, incense haze. Generated with a multiline Marble prompt via worldlabs-mcp.
gothic_cathedral.kiosk_note: Gallery-style prompt: nave, rose windows, god rays, wet stone. Adapted for Marble Adventure series tone.

cyberpunk_alley.spark_welcome: Neon Alley. Rain-slick cyberpunk backstreet. Spatial audio works in local Spark mode.
cyberpunk_alley.kiosk_note: Neon reflections, steam vents, narrow alley, holographic signs. Night, light rain.

sea_of_fog.spark_welcome: Sea of Fog. Romantic mist above silent valleys. First stop on the shape tour: circle.
sea_of_fog.kiosk_note: Caspar Friedrich mood: figure-scale path, infinite mist, soft sunrise.

wonderland.spark_welcome: Wonderland. Floating bioluminescent islands. Escher meets Gaudi.
wonderland.kiosk_note: Impossible architecture, glowing flora, dreamlike scale.

japanese_temple.spark_welcome: Zen Temple. Autumn maples, koi pond, quiet garden.
japanese_temple.kiosk_note: Temple garden, maple crimson, stone lantern, still water.

midcentury_villa.spark_welcome: Midcentury Villa. Golden-hour modernist pool and gardens.
midcentury_villa.kiosk_note: Bonus ring. Palm shadows, infinity pool, tropical modernism.

deep_forest.spark_welcome: Deep Forest. Redwood light, moss, forgotten ruins.
deep_forest.kiosk_note: Bonus ring. Dappled green light, ancient trees, stone arch.

underwater_ruins.spark_welcome: Sunken Ruins. Greco-Roman columns under bioluminescent sea.
underwater_ruins.kiosk_note: Bonus ring. God rays underwater, coral glow, marble columns.
